review_notes: I read the whole file but did not open any related sources or check any lemmas against them. The only repetition is inside G23One.closure_letters_eq. First, hA1 and hC1 use the same closure_mono, simp and tauto script. Second, the four letter cases in hL differ only in which hypothesis (hA or hC) and which bound (le_one or le_two) they use. Each block is a few lines of routine set-membership unfolding. A shared lemma would save little and would only replace one local `have` with another. The rubric excludes short calculations, routine unfolding and helpers that merely move duplicated branches, so I report no finding. slGen4_mem, foldSL_mem, foldSL_val and sl_closure_top each do different work, and the same reasoning is not repeated across them. I am fairly confident in this verdict.
